references.text: The same theme about keeping God's commands so that it may go well with you and your children after you
God's desire for the people to fear Him and keep His commands, so that it may go well with them
Promise of blessing for those who hear and keep God's word
Encouragement to do what is right and good in the Lord's eyes so that it may go well with you
Promise of the Lord's mercy when one does what is right in His eyes and keeps His commands
King David is praised for doing what was right in the Lord's eyes
Encouragement not to forget God's teaching, for this brings long life and happiness
Promise of protection from disease for those who do what is right in the Lord's eyes and keep His commands
